title: Espaces stratifiés et voisinages côniques (ou : déploiement des espaces stratifiés) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (built up over the preceding pages). We have a stratified space X whose strata X_i are indexed by a poset I. Each stratum carries a tubular neighbourhood T_i, with interior T̊_i and boundary Ṫ_i. For a subset J ⊂ I, X_J is the union of the strata X_j with j ∈ J, and J̄ is the ideal (downward closure) generated by J. The piece Σ_J = X_J minus X_J ∩ T̊_{J̄∖J} is X_J with the open tubes of the lower strata cut out. This is the 'déploiement', i.e. the unfolding of X into manifold-with-corners pieces Σ_d indexed by flags d ∈ Drap(I), with gluing formulas of the type Σ_J ≅ colim_{d ∈ Drap(J)} Σ_d.

This page relativises that construction from single strata to pairs of 'bandes'. A bande is a convex subset of I. Take two disjoint bands J < L and a band I' in which J is an ideal and L a coideal. Necessarily I' = J̃ ∩ L̄, where J̃ is the upward closure of J and L̄ the downward closure of L. Set J' = I'∖L, which gives a chain of ideals J ⊂ J' ⊂ I' (this uses J ∩ L = ∅).

Two parallel diagrams are drawn.
- Spaces: X_J ⊂ X_{J'} ⊂ X_{I'}, sitting over X_{J_0} → X_{J'_0} ← X_{I'_0}, with both squares marked cartesian.
- Posets: J̄ ⊃ J̄' ⊃ Ī' over J_0, J'_0, I'_0, where J_0 = J̄∖J, J'_0 = J̄'∖J' (probably) and I'_0 = Ī'∖I' are the 'lower boundary' index sets.

These yield inclusions Σ_J ⊂ Σ_{J'} ⊂ Σ_{I'}, each piece being X_K with the open tubes of the strata indexed by K_0 removed. He then proposes to study the tubular neighbourhood of Σ_J inside Σ_{J'} (and, on the next page, inside Σ_{I'}).

The left margin records the intended definitions and conjectures:
- Σ_{J,L} := T̊_J ∩ Σ_L, the 'relative link' of the band J in the band L;
- Ṫ_J = Σ_{J,I};
- conjectured colimit formulas (marked '?'): Ṫ_J ≅ colim over flags d ∈ Drap(I) whose initial term lies in J of Σ_d, and Σ_{J,L} ≅ colim over flags d ∈ Drap(J ∪ L) with initial term in J and final term in L of Σ_d.

The next page carries this out: (75)-(78) define T_{Σ_J,Σ_{I'}}, its boundary and Σ^♮_{J,L}, and assert the flag-colimit formula 'sauf erreur'. It also gives the projection Σ^♮_{J,L} → Σ_J alongside the inclusion into Σ_L.

Purpose: a combinatorial, flag-indexed description of all generalized links between convex pieces of the stratification. The aim is to reconstruct X and its links as colimits of the corner-pieces Σ_d. This is the 'dévissage' of a tame stratified space into a diagram indexed by flags.
errors: The claim I' = J̃ ∩ L̄ is correct, given the assumption I' ⊂ J̃ ∩ L̄ and convexity of I'. For this one must read J < L as: every j lies below some l and every l lies above some j. Under that reading J is automatically an ideal of I' and L a coideal.
The first column of the Σ-row reads X_J minus X_J ∩ T̊_{I_0} (or I'_0). By his own definition this should be T̊_{J_0}, with J_0 = J̄∖J. This is probably a slip of the pen.
The transcribed J'_0 = J̄'∖J should presumably read J̄'∖J', for consistency with J_0 and I'_0.

The colimit formulas for Ṫ_J and Σ_{J,L} are only conjectured ('?', 'sauf erreur'). They hold up to homeomorphism or homotopy only under suitable Thom–Mather/control conditions on the tubes, which are not checked here.
The marginal remark admits that the hypothesis on J ∩ L̄ has not been handled consistently. The definition of Σ_{J,L} for general (non-separated) bands is left unsettled.

ideas.what: Unfolding of a stratified space into pieces Σ_J = X_J minus open tubes of the lower strata, with X and Σ_J recovered as colimits of corner-pieces Σ_d indexed by flags of the stratification poset
ideas.modern_name: Resolution / unfolding / 'unzipping' of Thom–Mather stratified spaces into manifolds with corners; décollage-type descriptions as diagrams on the subdivision sd(P)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Verona (1984, resolution of stratified spaces); Albin–Leichtnam–Mazzeo–Piazza; Ayala–Francis–Tanaka (unzipping, 2017); Douteau, Haine, Barwick–Glasman–Haine for the sd(P)-diagram homotopy theory
ideas.where_published: Sketched in Esquisse d'un Programme §5 (dévissage of tame stratified structures via tubular neighbourhoods and flag-indexed systems), without details

ideas.what: Bands (convex subposets) J < L, with I' = J̃ ∩ L̄ the convex hull in which J is an ideal and L a coideal; the chain of ideals J ⊂ J' ⊂ I' and the cartesian diagrams of strata unions and of their 'lower boundary' index sets
ideas.modern_name: Convex / interval subposets and the corresponding locally closed unions of strata; recollement along open-closed decompositions
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard in stratified-space and perverse-sheaf literature (e.g. BBD recollement)

ideas.what: Relative link Σ_{J,L} = T̊_J ∩ Σ_L of one band in another, with conjectured formula Σ_{J,L} ≅ colim over flags in J ∪ L beginning in J and ending in L of Σ_d; Ṫ_J = Σ_{J,I}
ideas.modern_name: Generalized (homotopy) links holink_{J,L} for subposets; the restriction of the sd(P)-diagram to flags from J to L
ideas.usually_credited_to: Quinn (homotopy links, 1988); Douteau and Haine for generalized holinks of sub-posets and flag-indexed decompositions

missed.claim: Grothendieck sets up a systematic calculus of relative links between arbitrary convex pieces (bands) of the stratification poset. Each such link is expressed point-set-theoretically, inside a fixed system of tubes, as a colimit of the corner-pieces Σ_d over flags starting in J and ending in L. He leaves the formula conjectural and the non-separated case unresolved. Modern treatments (Douteau, Haine) obtain such statements homotopically via holinks on sd(P). They do not provide an explicit geometric 'band link' calculus credited to these notes.
missed.quote: Σ_{J,L} ≟ lim→ over d ∈ Drap(J∪L), id. initial de d ∈ J, coidéal ∈ L, of Σ_d
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is a point-set model, inside a manifold-with-corners unfolding, for the generalized holinks used in the exodromy and stratified-homotopy literature. It shows Grothendieck anticipating the sd(P)/décollage viewpoint in concrete geometric form.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a careful but routine step in the unfolding programme announced in the Esquisse. The relative links of bands with flag-colimit formulas anticipate the later holink/sd(P) framework. The idea is now known in homotopical form, and the page itself is tentative.
transcription_corrections: Margin first line likely begins 'Je ne me suis pas placé dans l'hypothèse ... que J ∩ L̄ = ∅'. It is largely illegible; the transcription's content is approximate.
'J'_0 = J̄'∖J' probably reads J̄'∖J' (prime on the second J).
The first column of the Σ-row is written X_J minus X_J ∩ T̊_{I'_0} (or I_0); mathematically it should be T̊_{J_0}.
'Considérons [-X*_J ⊂ X*_{J'}-]' is correct as a struck-out phrase followed by 'le diagramme'.
The last line is 'Considérons donc le voisinage tubulaire de Σ_J dans Σ_{J'}' (ending Σ_{J'}, as transcribed).
